name: MADAR — Actual System Connections — Evidence Map 2026-11-13

parameters.content:
## Runtime / network

**NET-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Browser / APK HTTPS client → HTTPS :443 → existing Tailscale ingress → /api/health → Express API :3000
madar-v2/server/app.js:88
Reachability and service identity only; does not prove a business transaction or every handset.

**WEB-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
React build → GET /, /rep/, /assets/RepApp-*.js → Served web / representative UI
madar-v2/server/app.js:190, madar-v2/client/src/modules/rep/RepApp.jsx:1


**APK-01 — IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED**
Previously distributed 2.0.8 APK (unchanged by this server/web stability update) → Existing com.madar.rep.app 2.0.8 (10), not rebuilt in this change → Published release / transition APK
madar-v2/scripts/build-android.js:124, madar-v2/android/version.properties:1
Previous artifact checks are historical; no new build or physical-device installation is claimed.

**APK-02 — IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED**
Authenticated download endpoint → GET /download/apk; /download/apk/debug-transition → Release APK / Debug transition
madar-v2/server/config/paths.js:25, madar-v2/server/app.js:92
Published files and runtime path selection verified; unauthenticated requests return 401. No authenticated production download session available.

## Authentication

**AUTH-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Web / representative login → POST /api/auth/login; /api/rep/login → sessions → requireAuthentication → Session DB and role middleware
madar-v2/server/modules/auth/service.js:212, madar-v2/server/modules/auth/service.js:261


**AUTH-02 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Admin / supervisor / finance / rep requests → Per-route role checks and account ownership → Authorized API modules
madar-v2/server/app.js:164, madar-v2/server/modules/auth/authorization.js:7
Isolated HTTP tests; live calls only prove anonymous requests are rejected.

## Representative / location

**REP-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Assigned maintenance order → GET /api/rep/today-route → local cache → grouped cards → Representative route / alphabetic region folders
madar-v2/server/modules/rep/service.js:169, madar-v2/client/src/modules/rep/route-folders.js:4


**REP-02 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Representative starts machine work → POST start-work / stop-work → rep_machine_work_leases → Lease / other representative route visibility
madar-v2/server/modules/rep/service.js:313, madar-v2/server/modules/rep/service.js:249
Other online rep loses the card after authoritative route refresh; offline cached screens cannot receive instant updates; lease expiry/release restores eligibility.

**LOC-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
First GPS confirmation on unlocated machine → POST /api/rep/machines/:id/confirm-location → SQLite → route → Locked approved coordinates and dependent visit
madar-v2/server/modules/rep/service.js:710, madar-v2/client/src/modules/rep/RepApp.jsx:1752
First location path and subsequent correction path are separate; no universal autoapproval claim.

**LOC-02 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Correction request plus evidence → Multipart corrections → pending request → review event → Supervisor approve / reject → route reconciliation
madar-v2/server/modules/rep/service.js:940, madar-v2/server/modules/supervisor/routes.js:107


**MAP-01 — IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED**
Assigned coordinates / representative GPS → map packs, /api/rep/map/google, Google Maps navigation URL → Local MBTiles / Google view / directions
madar-v2/client/src/modules/rep/OfflineMapPanel.jsx:70, madar-v2/client/src/modules/rep/map-utils.js:12
Projection and URL helpers tested; external map key, offline package availability and phone navigation not accepted on a device.

## Android / durable queues

**CAM-01 — BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE**
Native consecutive camera capture → Capacitor bridge → RepCameraSequenceActivity → RepPhotoArchive → Before / After evidence, watermark and local archive
madar-v2/android/app/src/main/java/com/madar/rep/app/RepCameraSequenceActivity.java:49, madar-v2/android/app/src/main/java/com/madar/rep/app/RepPhotoArchive.java:19, madar-v2/client/src/modules/rep/native-bridges.js:56
No physical device connected. Source, packaging and server watermark tests cannot prove OEM camera / GPS / SAF behavior.

**QUEUE-01 — BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE**
Saved visit / machine action / attendance → RepLocalStore → MadarSyncWorker; account-scoped stable operation identities → SQLite → WorkManager → HTTP upload
madar-v2/android/app/src/main/java/com/madar/rep/app/RepLocalStore.java:19, madar-v2/android/app/src/main/java/com/madar/rep/app/MadarSyncWorker.java:40, madar-v2/client/src/modules/rep/native-bridges.js:94
Server contracts and JS recovery tested. Native process death/reboot/upgrade and real background upload not executed here.

**RECOVERY-01 — BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE**
Pending native visits / files / ownership → RepRecoveryValidator / RepRecoveryImporter → same-owner queue → Recovery export / validated import
madar-v2/android/app/src/main/java/com/madar/rep/app/RepRecoveryValidator.java:15, madar-v2/android/app/src/main/java/com/madar/rep/app/RepRecoveryImporter.java:11
JS recovery package tests passed; complete physical-phone export/reinstall/import drill unverified.

**GPS-01 — BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE**
Native location provider / foreground service → RepLocationService → RepTrackStore → Durable local GPS identity ledger
madar-v2/android/app/src/main/java/com/madar/rep/app/RepLocationService.java:27, madar-v2/android/app/src/main/java/com/madar/rep/app/RepTrackStore.java:16
Actual GPS enabled detection, OEM background policy and battery behavior require a phone.

## Visits / supervisor

**GPS-02 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Offline points after duty closes → POST /api/rep/location-ping → stored/duplicate/rejected; session preserved → Server point ledger / per-point receipt
madar-v2/server/modules/rep/service.js:1585, madar-v2/server/modules/rep/tracking-ledger.js:3
Server isolated integration. Phone acknowledgment cleanup remains device acceptance, not a server test claim.

**VISIT-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Multipart visit with stable UUID / payload → POST /api/rep/sync-visit; staged writes; rep_visits/reviews/lines → Durable files + completed ingestion + pending review
madar-v2/server/modules/rep/service.js:1254, madar-v2/server/modules/rep/routes.js:370


**VISIT-02 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Supervisor QA / bulk approval / reshoot → POST /api/supervisor/visits/:id/review; /visits/approve-all → Approved card or reshoot request + event
madar-v2/server/modules/supervisor/service.js:376, madar-v2/server/modules/supervisor/service.js:554


**VISIT-03 — IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED**
Review / submission event → SSE or native realtime → refreshData → route filters → APK sent tab / remaining card / reshoot reconciliation
madar-v2/client/src/modules/rep/RepApp.jsx:983, madar-v2/client/src/modules/rep/RepApp.jsx:1577
Server statuses verified; installed APK final visual reconciliation not exercised on a physical phone.

**RADAR-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
GPS points / duty sessions / visits → GET /api/supervisor/radar; /reps/:id/route → Supervisor all-rep radar and per-rep route
madar-v2/server/modules/supervisor/service.js:111, madar-v2/server/modules/supervisor/service.js:194
Isolated API assertions; displayed instantaneous/average speed depends on valid point timestamps and samples, not vehicle telemetry calibration.

## Attendance / HR

**ATT-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Offline attendance action → POST /api/rep/attendance/sync → action ledger → attendance → Age-window validation / replay / review and attendance
madar-v2/server/modules/employees/attendance.js:73, madar-v2/client/src/modules/rep/RepApp.jsx:851


**ATT-02 — BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE**
Device credential / biometric client result → RepBiometricAuth → attendance bridge → server request → Attendance client assurance assertion
madar-v2/android/app/src/main/java/com/madar/rep/app/RepBiometricAuth.java:13, madar-v2/client/src/modules/rep/native-bridges.js:82
Phone assurance is a client assertion; no independent server hardware attestation or physical biometric acceptance established.

**HR-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Linked login / employee master and attendance → staff sync → attendance → payroll finalization transaction → Payroll preview / finalized treasury expense
madar-v2/server/modules/employees/staff-service.js:126, madar-v2/server/modules/employees/service.js:654


**HR-02 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Employee tools / advances / maintenance custody → employee tools and custody APIs → durable records → Custody / finance history / audit
madar-v2/server/modules/employees/service.js:275, madar-v2/server/modules/employees/service.js:599

## Maintenance / reporting

**MAINT-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Client and machine business identities → clients → machines → maintenance_order_reps → assigned route → Orders / cards / representative assignments
madar-v2/server/modules/clients/service.js:52, madar-v2/server/modules/maintenance/routes.js:418


**MAINT-02 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Countable reasons with explicit quantities → typed catalog → line snapshots / provenance → approved business exports → Card/visit lines → analytics → PPTX / DOCX / XLSX
madar-v2/server/modules/maintenance/analysis.js:46, madar-v2/server/modules/maintenance/export.js:660
Exact quantity examples and export assertions, not every historical customer record.

**MAINT-03 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Original uploaded images → storage containment → photo-images/thumbnails → exports → Derived rotation / thumbnails / export buffers
madar-v2/server/modules/maintenance/photo-images.js:8, madar-v2/server/modules/maintenance/thumbnails.js:46, madar-v2/server/modules/storage.js:60


**MAINT-04 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Folder / spreadsheet import → trip-folder matching / EXIF ordering / import routes → Non-destructive matched machine and photo records
madar-v2/server/modules/maintenance/trip-folder.js:407, madar-v2/server/modules/maintenance/routes.js:266


**MAINT-05 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Order deletion / training fixture deletion → delete routes → locks → stage rename → rollback/startup recovery → Staged file removal / DB transaction / recovery
madar-v2/server/modules/maintenance/routes.js:438, madar-v2/server/modules/maintenance/routes.js:442

## Workshop / stock / finance

**STOCK-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Whole main-warehouse material issue → issueMaterial transaction and explicit rounded issue choice → Stock movements / sub-warehouse reusable offcut
madar-v2/server/modules/warehouse/service.js:165


**WORKSHOP-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Workshop order + material issue → production → ready → delivered_archived → Ready offcuts / delivered sales invoice
madar-v2/server/modules/workshop/service.js:285, madar-v2/server/modules/workshop/service.js:327


**FIN-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Purchase invoice → createPurchaseInvoice → recordPurchasePayment → Stock receipt + unpaid liability; separate payment
madar-v2/server/modules/finance/invoices.service.js:174, madar-v2/server/modules/finance/invoices.service.js:328
Integer cents and isolated retries/concurrency tested; no bank/payment-provider integration claimed.

**FIN-02 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Sales receipt / purchase payment stable operation ID → Identical replay returns committed result; changed payload conflicts → Settlement + treasury + invoice balance + audit
madar-v2/server/modules/finance/invoices.service.js:411, madar-v2/server/modules/finance/invoices.service.js:328

## Events / notification

**EVENT-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Business producers → publishOperationsEvent → operations_events/outbox → rep/supervisor SSE → Persisted outbox/event log and bounded SSE replay
madar-v2/server/modules/operations-events.js:124, madar-v2/server/modules/operations-events.js:43, madar-v2/server/modules/rep/routes.js:87
Single-process deployment. Client API reconciliation remains authoritative; not an unbounded broker.

**EVENT-02 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Persisted business event → materializeNotificationsForEvent → /api/notifications → bell → User-owned inbox / bell / read and dismiss
madar-v2/server/modules/notifications/service.js:58, madar-v2/client/src/components/notifications/NotificationBell.jsx:120
Foreground/live-browser or open-app synchronization; no closed-app push delivery claim.

**PUSH-01 — NOT_IMPLEMENTED**
Closed application → No implemented FCM/APNs registration or delivery path found → External push delivery
madar-v2/client/src/modules/rep/native-bridges.js:23
Optional capability / product decision, not a mandatory defect. No alert destination configured in this n8n delivery.

## Persistence / recovery

**DB-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
API services / additive initialization → migrations → transactions / foreign keys → local DB → Single local SQLite WAL database
madar-v2/server/database/connection.js:7, madar-v2/server/database/init.js:92
Live integrity/foreign-key checks separately captured; no multi-instance SQLite scaling.

**BACKUP-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
SQLite snapshot + configured files → createSystemBackup / prepareRestorableSnapshot / interrupted restore journal → Backup ZIP → isolated migration → restored state / rollback
madar-v2/server/modules/system/backup.js:653, madar-v2/server/modules/system/backup.js:265, madar-v2/server/modules/system/backup.js:488
See restore-drill.json for actual existing ZIP extraction/migration evidence; no production restore or off-device recovery claim.

**BACKUP-02 — BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE**
Mounted local backups → External storage on same host does not itself prove off-device backup → Off-device disaster recovery / physical restore drill
madar-v2/server/config/paths.js:21
No authorized fresh off-device restore drill evidence supplied.

## n8n / separate projects

**N8N-01 — VERIFIED_PASS**
Manual n8n verifier → HTTP Request nodes with timeout and bounded safe retry → Actual read-only API / web / auth-boundary probes
madar-v2/server/app.js:88
Workflow runtime evidence captured separately. Not inserted into business transactions.

**N8N-02 — IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED**
Existing scheduled CI health workflow → Existing Execute Command workflow (not modified) → Local check script / execution metadata
madar-v2/scripts/n8n-system-check.mjs:65
Existing 06:00 Cairo success predates this audit. Do not equate it with complete current business verification.

**LEGACY-01 — NOT_APPLICABLE**
Legacy system/ data → migrate-from-v1; separate codebase, not a live second V2 service → One-time migration into V2
madar-v2/scripts/migrate-from-v1.js:2
No automatic live synchronization between legacy and V2 established.

**FLOW-01 — NOT_APPLICABLE**
madar-flow project → Separate project; no demonstrated production integration to V2 or n8n → Separate workflow editor/runtime
madar-flow/README.md:1
Do not treat its canvas, routes or graph engine as n8n or proof of MADAR V2 business integration.

# Documentary architecture only
Revision `16d5cc92294d7fd4f5bfe7298666fe4d25f29782`
Report: audit/stability-20261113/README.md
These conceptual producer/interface/consumer connections do not execute business integration. VERIFIED_PASS applies only to named evidence. NoOp placeholders are not functional checks. Reused earlier workflow identity; no live activation.
